pools.retrievalQuestion: Asset selection unexpectedly includes nested files for a root-only glob and includes hidden files for ordinary wildcard patterns. Fix selectPaths so matching uses each full supplied root-relative POSIX path. A pattern without a slash must not implicitly match a nested basename. Hidden path segments must be excluded unless the corresponding pattern explicitly names the dot. Preserve supported globstar, brace, and explicit dot patterns, input order, duplicates, and caller data.

The settings reader silently accepts multiple YAML documents and duplicate mapping keys. Fix readSettings to accept exactly one nonempty YAML document whose root is a mapping. Reject an empty stream, multiple documents, duplicate keys, syntax errors, scalars and sequences with {ok:false,error:'invalid-settings'} without throwing. Accepted mappings must preserve their parsed values. Keep the exported result shape and function name.
